_loader_notes: App microcopy. Keep in the app as one strings file (e.g. src/copy/en-GB.json) rather than in Supabase, so it ships with the build and works offline.
{placeholders} are filled by the app. Prices, billing periods and trial lengths always come from RevenueCat.
Sentence case everywhere except eyebrows (small uppercase labels). UK spelling. No em dashes.
Never show streak-loss or guilt copy (AGENTS.md Group 3). Never show countdowns or urgency on offers (AGENTS.md C1).
Empty strings mean 'show nothing' (e.g. a user cancelling the purchase sheet needs no message).

first_session_bullets: Ascenda gives general fitness guidance, not medical advice.
Check with your GP first if you're pregnant, injured or have a health condition.
Stop and get help if you feel chest pain, dizziness or sharp pain.
Use weights you can lift with good form, and never train through pain.
safety.footer_line: Train within your limits. Read the safety guidance

how_it_works: Share your link or code with a friend who is new to Ascenda.
She gets {friend_trial_days} days free instead of 7 when she starts the annual plan.
When she becomes a paying subscriber, you get a month free, up to {max_rewards} a year.
terms: Your friend needs to be new to Ascenda.

If you have a paid Apple subscription, the free month is added to it. If you don't, we unlock a month in the app for you.
